title: Edit laboratory profile
purpose: Change the address, contact details and certificate statement printed on new reports.
summary: Change the address, contact details and certificate statement that new reports print.

tasks.title: Update the address or contacts
steps: Select [[Save changes]]. New reports print the new details.

tasks.title: Write your own certificate statement
steps: Enter it in [[Certificate statement]]. Leave it blank to print the default statement.

good_to_know: Reports already issued keep the details they printed.
A blank detail is simply left off reports.
The website must start with https:// or http://.
If the profile or logo changed after you opened the form, saving is refused. Reload and compare first.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin laboratory role can open or submit this form. Every field is optional; surrounding spaces are removed. A blank detail is left off reports. The laboratory name is set when the application is installed and is not changed here.

items.label: Street address
items.description: Up to 160 characters, the first address line.

items.label: Suite, building or PO box
items.description: Up to 160 characters, the second address line.

items.label: City, State, ZIP code
items.description: Printed together on the last address line, for example Testville, NY 10000. State is chosen from the US states and territories; ZIP code takes up to 12 characters.

items.label: Phone
items.description: Up to 40 characters, printed as entered.

items.label: Email
items.description: Must be a valid email address.

items.label: Website
items.description: Must be a full web address starting with https:// or http://.

items.label: Certificate statement
items.description: Up to 600 characters. Printed under the certificate list on reports that list at least one certificate. Leave it blank to print the default statement, which is shown in the field’s help.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to the Laboratory profile. The change is audited with the administrator, the time and the values before and after, and applies to reports issued from then on. An unchanged submission returns with No changes to save and records nothing.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the Laboratory profile without saving.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the profile changed after you opened the form (including a logo change), saving is refused and your input stays on the form; reload and compare the current values before saving again.
